lines.zh: 我从月亮的边缘走下来。
lines.en: I walk down from the edge of the moon.
I tread on light with every step.
I come at you, slow and steady.
My cloak trails the night.

lines.zh: 我落在屋顶，再从屋顶下来。
lines.en: I land on the roof, then come down.
Stars dim as I pass.
I do not detour and look at nothing else.
My steps bend the grass.

lines.zh: 我从地平线那边一路走来。
lines.en: I have walked here from the horizon.

lines.zh: 我走到你门前停了一下。
lines.en: I stop once at your door.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方影子很长。
lines.en: My shadow is long where I pass.
No hurry; I always arrive.
I hover, looking up at the moon.
My cloak hangs with no wind.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，掌心向上。
lines.en: I raise a palm upward.
I await the proper hour.
I stand with stars behind me.

lines.zh: 我没有表情地看你这边。
lines.en: I look your way without expression.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓把月光挡住了。
lines.en: My outline blocks the moonlight.
I have said nothing for a long time.
My presence settles at my feet.
I stay still, and so does the sky.
I slowly close my fingers.
I lower my head slightly.
My cloak slowly darkens.
I am weighing whether you are worth it.
I look down at you, clear-eyed.
My eyes are like two cold stars.

lines.zh: 你要么击败我，要么失去一切。
lines.en: Either you defeat me or you lose everything.
I raise a hand and moonlight falls on your shoulder.
I have come to a stop before you.
My expression is very calm.

lines.zh: 我从月亮上下来，先看你抬哪只手。
lines.en: I came down from the moon; show me which hand first.
You have raised your weapon.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看一场旧戏。
lines.en: I watch you like an old play.

lines.zh: 我没有敌意，也没有好意。
lines.en: I bear neither hostility nor kindness.

lines.zh: 我的斗篷轻轻翻了一层。
lines.en: One fold of my cloak turns.
I give the faintest nod.
The whole night sky is behind you.
I know you will not back down.

lines.zh: 我从月亮上下来，就为看你一眼。
lines.en: I came down from the moon just to look at you.
I let moonlight fall on your face.

lines.zh: 你已经站在我的影子里。
lines.en: You are already inside my shadow.
I step back, my cloak disordered.

lines.zh: 我的光暗了一瞬，又亮起来。
lines.en: My light dims for an instant, then returns.
I press my struck shoulder.
I have not a sound.
My gaze turns colder.
I steady my form again.
Moonlight scatters off me.
My fingers stiffen.
I slowly let out a breath.
I glance, entirely uninterested.
Under the moon such things mean nothing.
I return it into your hand.
I lift a hand and it drops.

lines.zh: 我不能被这样的东西收买。
lines.en: I cannot be bought by such things.
It gives no light at my feet.
I shake my head slowly.
I step over it.
Food is not what I seek.
You hit me like hitting the night.
My cloak parts and closes.
I hold you one block away.
We shatter the moonlight between us.
I did not yield; you did.
You cross my shadow, and it is cold.
My backhand grazes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 地面被我们踩出两个圈。
lines.en: We leave two circles on the ground.
There is no sound between us.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的影子，就够近了。
lines.en: You brushed my shadow; that is close enough.

lines.zh: 两个从天而降的影子并肩。
lines.en: Two shadows from above stand together.
We trade a glance of moonlight.
Her hand rests on my wrist.
We look up at the moon together.

lines.zh: 我们的斗篷连成一片夜。
lines.en: Our cloaks join into one night.
We raise our hands at once.
We have no chance to speak.
Her presence and mine press together.
Our shadows merge.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝同一个方向看。
lines.en: We look the same way.
I lift a hand and it rises.
I carry it on moonlight.
I look at it and set it back.
It stops glowing in my hand.
I draw it into my cloak.
I squeeze and it deforms.
I hold it under the moon.
I let it fall on its own.
I hand it to someone nearby.
I fix my gaze on you.
The moon has moved to my side.
You have chosen a path.
I lower my hand into a fist.
From this moment, it is my turn.
My cloak billows upward.
I begin closing on you.
I know how this ends.

lines.zh: 星星在我背后排成一线。
lines.en: The stars line up behind me.

lines.zh: 世界的自由压在这一场上。
lines.en: The world's freedom rests on this.
I have not a shred of hesitation left.
My presence rises to my feet.
You have been chosen.
Moonlight thickens around you.
I raise a hand and the sky lowers.

lines.zh: 我一直朝你走，从不迷路。
lines.en: I keep walking at you and never lose the way.
I go around the traps you set.
You retreat; I take one block.
I rest on your roof.
You do not look up; I am still there.

lines.zh: 月光把你的路照得很亮。
lines.en: The moonlight makes your path bright.
Step by step I shorten the distance.
You hear something on the roof.
I never shout and never run.

lines.zh: 你在门后，我在门外的夜里。
lines.en: You are behind the door; I am in the night outside.
I have pulled the whole sky lower.

lines.zh: 你走了三条路，我都看着。
lines.en: You tried three routes; I watched all.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住你的营地。
lines.en: My shadow covers your camp.

lines.zh: 你开始数着月亮的高度。
lines.en: You start measuring the moon's height.
I have no need of sleep.
I can hear your breathing.
I stop two blocks away and hold.

lines.zh: 你再退就退到地平线了。
lines.en: Retreat further and you reach the horizon.
I am still here at dawn.
I drive a palm toward your chest.

lines.zh: 月光顺着我的手打下去。
lines.en: Moonlight falls with my hand.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩，按向地面。
lines.en: I seize your shoulder and press you down.
My cloak grazes across your face.

lines.zh: 我从月亮上下来，只为这一战。
lines.en: I came down from the moon for this.

lines.zh: 你挡住，光从缝里漏进来。
lines.en: You block and the light leaks through.
A backhand snaps at your neck.
You are pressed to one knee.
I drop from above onto you.
After the blow I step back.
You heard no wind at all.

lines.zh: 我的指尖在你肩上留下凉。
lines.en: My fingertips leave cold on your shoulder.
You roll away from the second.
I push you out of the ring of light.
I wait for you to stand before the next blow.

lines.zh: 月亮忽然被挡住了一块。
lines.en: A piece of the moon is suddenly blocked.
A stillness descends from the sky.
I land in the middle of your yard.
The stars suddenly line up.
I have come down from the moon's side.
The air sinks a notch.
A far hilltop brightens.

lines.zh: 你听见很远的地方有落地声。
lines.en: You hear a landing far away.
I begin to exist, and the sky changes.
My cloak drops into the night first.

lines.zh: 我站在月光最亮的地方。
lines.en: I stand where the moonlight is brightest.
This night is longer than before.
I slowly gather out of the light.
There is a shadow on your roof.
The wind stopped in midair.
I raise a hand and the sky goes quiet.

lines.zh: 这个世界的自由开始计时。
lines.en: The world's freedom begins to count down.

lines.zh: 我落在离你十格的地方。
lines.en: I land ten blocks from you.

lines.zh: 旧夜的冷从上面压下来。
lines.en: The cold of an old night presses down.

lines.zh: 火焰烧着我的斗篷，我拍灭了。
lines.en: Fire eats my cloak; I put it out.

lines.zh: 我从月亮的高度坠下，砸在地上。
lines.en: I fall from the moon's height and hit the ground.
Water pulls me down from the sky.
The blast tears my cloak open.
An arrow lands and the light leaks out.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我钉在原地。
lines.en: That force nails me in place.
I do not eat; I only fade.

lines.zh: 雷与我撞在一起，天亮了。
lines.en: Lightning meets me and the sky lights up.

lines.zh: 脚下的夜空张开，我坠进去。
lines.en: The night below opens and I fall in.
